high_level_description: The image depicts a woman standing outdoors at night, holding an award. She is wearing a vibrant red dress with a fitted bodice and a flared skirt that reaches her knees. The dress has a sleek, elegant design with a high neckline and no sleeves. The woman has long, dark hair that falls over her shoulders. She is holding a wooden award plaque with a certificate attached to it. The text on the certificate reads "RISING REPRODUCTIVE FREEDOM CHAMPION" and includes a date: "September 18, 2024." The background shows a dark brick wall and part of a building entrance
